name: Figma
tagline: Read, search, comment on, and export from Figma files — design-to-code without leaving chat.
description: Talks to the Figma REST API on your behalf. Five tools: pull a file overview, read the node tree (frames, text, components), export PNG / JPG / SVG / PDF at any scale, search by text or layer name, and post pinned comments back. Ships with a `design-handoff` skill the agent loads on demand — covers URL parsing, orient-then-drill workflow, export defaults, spec extraction, and rate-limit handling. Read-side only; modifying the canvas requires Figma's in-app plugin runtime which isn't reachable from here.
